name: FastAPI Backend & Next.js Service Availability
procedure: Issue GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health and GET http://localhost:3000
expected: HTTP 200 with healthy database connection and all subsystems operational

name: Authentication Lifecycle (Password Verification, Session Management, Logout)
procedure: Test invalid credentials (401), valid login with PBKDF2/scrypt, /me check, logout revocation, and post-revocation request (401)
expected: Invalid login returns 401; valid login returns HttpOnly cookie/token; logout revokes session immediately
actual: Bad login status=401, Login status=200, Me authenticated=True, Logout status=200, Post-logout status=401

name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement Across 4 Roles
procedure: Verify ADMIN, INVESTIGATOR, REVIEWER, and VIEWER access against privileged and read-only endpoints
expected: ADMIN has full access; INVESTIGATOR cannot access user management; REVIEWER cannot create cases; VIEWER can only read
actual: Admin users: 200, Inv users: 403, Rev create: 403, View create: 403, View read: 200

name: Cross-Investigation Isolation & Scoped Case Enforcement
procedure: Investigator A creates private case; Investigator B attempts GET and document upload to case A
expected: Unassigned case read and upload return 403 CROSS_INVESTIGATION_ACCESS_DENIED; case owner read returns 200
actual: Cross read status=403, Cross upload status=403, Owner read status=200

name: Frontend Persona & Header Spoofing Resistance
procedure: Send forged role headers (X-User-Role: ADMIN) on investigator token; request invalid demo persona; test switched token limits
expected: Backend derives identity and role strictly from verified SQLite session; forged headers ignored (403)
actual: Forged header status=403, Fake persona status=404, Switched reviewer admin test=403

name: Separation of Duties & Dossier Self-Approval Prevention
procedure: Attempt approval by INVESTIGATOR role (403), verify new dossier begins UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED, and attempt self-approval by creator (403)
expected: INVESTIGATOR forbidden from approving; new dossier is UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED; creator self-approval rejected with 403 SELF_DOSSIER_APPROVAL_PROHIBITED
actual: Investigator approve status=403, Initial status=UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED, Self-approval status=403

name: Unauthorized Document Download Protection & Security Headers
procedure: Attempt unauthenticated download (401), unauthorized cross-investigation download (403), and verify X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
expected: Unauthenticated downloads return 401; cross-case downloads return 403; authorized downloads return 200 with nosniff header
actual: Unauth status=401, Cross status=403, Auth status=200, nosniff=nosniff

name: Upload Security & Input Validation (Extension, Magic Bytes, File Size Limit)
procedure: Submit executable .sh script (400/422), spoofed .pdf containing script (400/422), and 26MB oversized payload (413/400/422)
expected: Disallowed extension rejected; spoofed magic bytes rejected; oversized file rejected
actual: Bad ext status=400, Spoofed status=400, Oversized status=413

name: Background Job Interruption Recovery & Audit Attribution
procedure: Simulate an ungraceful server termination during job execution by inserting RUNNING job into SQLite and running startup recovery
expected: Interrupted job transitions to FAILED with recovery diagnostic; audit ledger records BACKGROUND_JOB_INTERRUPTED_RECOVERED

evidence.error_message: Job was interrupted by server restart while RUNNING; ready for retry.

name: Audit Trail Cryptographic SHA-256 Hash-Chain Tamper Detection
procedure: Verify intact hash chain (chain_valid=True), modify SQLite row payload directly, re-run verification (chain_valid=False, tamper_detected=True), and restore original data
expected: Intact chain passes; tampered row triggers chain_valid=False and tamper_detected=True; restoration returns chain_valid=True
actual: Initial chain_valid=True, Tampered chain_valid=False, Tamper detected=True, Restored chain_valid=True

name: Historical Simulated Approval Labeling & Event Origin Distinction
procedure: Inspect database records for dossier reviews and audit logs to verify historical seeds are tagged HISTORICAL_SEED_SIMULATION
expected: Historical simulation events are distinctly tagged HISTORICAL_SEED_SIMULATION rather than AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN

name: Fresh Dossier AI Governance Lifecycle & Genuine Reviewer Approval
procedure: Generate fresh dossier, verify UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED, reject investigator approval (403), approve as Reviewer Marcus Vance, and inspect audit ledger
expected: Fresh dossier is UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED; investigator approval rejected; reviewer approval succeeds; audit ledger attributes AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN review to REVIEWER
actual: Initial status=UNAPPROVED_AI_ASSISTED, Inv approve status=403, Rev approve status=200, Audit origin=AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN

name: Guided Demo & Benchmark Data Isolation
procedure: Execute synthetic benchmark suite (POST /api/system/benchmark) and confirm no residual benchmark investigations pollute production data
expected: Benchmark completes successfully with 10 synthetic specimens; 0 benchmark investigations leaked into database; production investigations preserved
actual: Benchmark status=200, Production cases before/after=1/1, Leaked benchmark records=0
